items.title: Shipping code faster with o3, o4-mini, and GPT-4.1
items.summary: CodeRabbit uses OpenAI models to revolutionize code reviews—boosting accuracy, accelerating PR merges, and helping developers ship faster with fewer bugs and higher ROI.

items.title: Introducing Stargate UAE
items.summary: We’re launching Stargate UAE – the first international deployment of Stargate, OpenAI’s AI infrastructure platform.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI正式宣布启动“Stargate UAE”，这是OpenAI旗舰AI基础设施平台Stargate的首次国际部署，旨在满足中东地区日益增长的高性能AI计算需求。原始信息显示：We’re launching Stargate UAE – the first international deployment of Stargate, OpenAI’s AI infrastructure platform.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Introducing Stargate UAE”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI启动了Stargate计划的首个海外基础设施部署，标志着其在全球计算基础设施版图上的重大扩张。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
